name: Feishu WeChat Recovery Card Bridge
description: Fixed non-LLM command bridge for AliECS wechat-digest Feishu recovery cards.

probeOnly.description: Only acknowledge test cards in allowed chats. All decision submissions are blocked.

aliecsBaseUrl.description: AliECS backend base URL (or env NOTIFY_FEISHU_RECOVERY_BASE_URL).

actionToken.description: Shared service token sent via X-Notify-Feishu-Action-Token (or env NOTIFY_FEISHU_RECOVERY_GATEWAY_TOKEN).

allowedChatIds.description: Allowed Feishu group chat_id list (or env NOTIFY_FEISHU_RECOVERY_CHAT_ID).

allowedOperators.description: Allowed Feishu operator_open_id list (or env NOTIFY_FEISHU_RECOVERY_OPERATORS).

timeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout in milliseconds for AliECS feishu-choice. Native card callbacks cap this at 1800 ms.
